title: Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery
categories: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
description: Use this service request to request repairs/replacements or delivery of roll carts. For RESIDENTIAL CUSTOMERS ONLY, use to request new roll cart service (no roll carts are on property) or the additional/removal of a roll cart(s). All customers (Commercial/Business, Residential, or Multi-Family) can also use this request for the maintenance of existing roll cart(s). The fee for each additional residential garbage roll cart is $15.51. Effective October 1, 2023, the owner or occupant of a dwelling unit with one roll cart for recyclable materials may request one additional roll cart for recyclable materials from the director of sanitation for no additional fee. Dwelling units with two or more roll carts for recyclable materials may request additional roll carts for recyclable materials for a one-time processing and handling fee for $50.00 per roll cart, which will be applied to the dwelling unit’s water account. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 2 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for roll-cart repair, replacement, delivery, exchange, or removal.
actions.why: For residential customers seeking new or additional roll carts or removal of carts, and for residential, commercial, City-facility, or multifamily customers seeking maintenance of existing carts. The 311 request form offers repair, replacement, size exchange, additional or removed carts, and damaged-cart pickup, and asks about garbage or recycling, cart counts, account authority when relevant, and gate access.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery" requests cannot continue with account changes when the requester is neither the account holder nor authorized on the Dallas Water Utilities account. If an additional cart is sought to replace a lost or stolen cart, then select "Replace Roll Cart(s)" in the 311 request form instead.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery"
